nodes.name: Manual Test
nodes.notes: Use this to test the digest before activating the daily schedule.

nodes.name: Daily 8 AM IST
nodes.notes: Runs every day at 8:00 AM using the workflow timezone in Settings.

nodes.name: Fetch Jiva Daily Summary
nodes.notes: Before running, replace the placeholder header value with the same N8N_SUMMARY_SECRET configured in Jiva/Vercel.

nodes.name: Format Management Digest
nodes.notes: Produces subject, plainText, markdown, and html fields. Connect any delivery channel after this node.

nodes.name: Send Email Digest (configure)
nodes.notes: Disabled by default. Configure SMTP/email credentials, replace sender and recipients, then enable this node. You can also replace it with Slack, WhatsApp, Teams, or Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Digest Ready
nodes.notes: The formatted digest is available in the previous node output even if no delivery channel is configured yet.

parameters.content:
Setup checklist after import:

1. Open Fetch Jiva Daily Summary. Replace REPLACE_WITH_N8N_SUMMARY_SECRET with the shared secret configured in Jiva/Vercel.

2. Run Manual Test once. The Format Management Digest node should output subject, plainText, markdown, and html.

3. Configure a delivery channel. The email node is disabled by default so this workflow cannot send anything accidentally. Configure SMTP and recipients, then enable it, or replace it with WhatsApp/Slack/Teams/Google Sheets.

4. Confirm workflow Settings timezone is Asia/Kolkata.

5. Activate the workflow when the test output looks right.
